description: The figure is a horizontal grouped bar chart illustrating two model results across a set of text “Optimisations applied,” with one bar per model for each optimisation category. The category axis is the vertical axis labeled “Optimisations applied,” listing (from top to bottom) Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates; the categories are not shown as alphabetically ordered. The value axis is the horizontal axis with numeric tick labels at regular 0.001 intervals (0.000, 0.001, 0.002, 0.003), using a linear scale and extending slightly beyond 0.003 (to roughly 0.0036); no explicit unit is shown. Each category contains two horizontally aligned bars: an orange bar for the “NESAC ft model” and a green bar for the “SESHA ft model,” as indicated by the legend titled “Model” below the plot. The displayed values are annotated at the right end of each bar: for Normalised, NESAC (orange) is 0.00334 and SESHA (green) is 0.00323; for Add Spacing, NESAC is 0.00319 and SESHA is 0.00344; for Remove Spacing, NESAC is 0.00311 and SESHA is 0.00306; for Americanisms, NESAC is 0.00299 and SESHA is 0.00302; for Dates, NESAC is 0.00257 and SESHA is 0.00228. The shortest bar shown is the SESHA value for Dates (0.00228) and the longest is the SESHA value for Add Spacing (0.00344); no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and numeric end labels.
